lines.en: label beachmas12:

My phone goes off on the way to the normal breakfast hangout spot the girls have flocked to over our last several trips. But when I look down to inspect the sender, I am quickly filled with both fear and remorse.
lines.zh: 在前往女孩们这几次旅行都爱去的那个早餐聚集点的路上，我的手机响了。可当我低头查看发信人时，恐惧与懊悔立刻涌了上来。

lines.en: {i}You have received a text message from Maya Makinami!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你收到了一条来自 Maya Makinami 的短信！{/i}

lines.en: : ...shit.
Getting sidetracked on my quest to find the missing class members last night completely overwrote the plans I made with Maya earlier that day.
lines.zh: 昨晚我为了去找那些失踪的同学而分了心，彻底盖掉了我当天早些时候和 Maya 定下的计划。

lines.en: But if Maya knows me as well as she is supposed to, she should have expected such a thing and followed up with me rather than just {i}allowing{/i} me to forget her.
lines.zh: 不过如果 Maya 真像她自称的那样了解我，她早该料到这种事，主动来跟进，而不是就这么{i}任由{/i}我把她忘掉。

lines.en: Unless her plan was just keeping me from going on a date with Ayane instead. To which I say...smart.
lines.zh: 除非她的计划本来就是不让我去和 Ayane 约会。对此我只能说……高明。

lines.en: scene sky
: {i}Good morning. Are you still alive?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}早上好。你还活着吗？{/i}

lines.en: I swallow my pride and text her back to prove that my heart still beats, just not entirely for her.
lines.zh: 我咽下自尊，回短信证明我的心脏还在跳——只是不完全为她而跳。

lines.en: : {i}Good morning and yes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}早上好，还活着。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How unfortunate. I was beginning to hope that you had been mauled by bears as that would be the only reasonable explanation for bailing on the incredibly rare opportunity to go out on a date with me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真遗憾。我本来已经开始盼着你是被熊撕了，因为那是你放我鸽子、错过这千载难逢的约会机会的唯一合理解释。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There’s always your birthday next week.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不是还有下周你的生日嘛。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m shocked you’re able to remember that but not something twelve hours into the future.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真震惊，你记得住那个，却记不住十二小时之后的事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I forgot, Maya. I got caught up in something else.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我忘了，Maya。我被别的事缠住了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes, I realized that after watching you walk away from me without so much as a glance last night. But I suppose this is what I get for extending any amount of kindness to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，昨晚看着你头也不回地从我身边走开，我就明白了。不过我想，这就是我对你释放哪怕一丝善意的下场。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Texting with you sure is fun. We should do this more often.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}跟你发短信真有意思。我们应该多来几次。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Delete my number and never talk to me again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}删了我的号码，永远别再跟我说话。{/i}

lines.en: Welp, it’s safe to say that Maya is mad. And understandably so.
lines.zh: 好吧，可以肯定地说，Maya 生气了。而且情有可原。

lines.en: But the silver lining to this is that I made similar arrangements with her arch-nemesis tonight and, if the past repeats itself (Which it so typically does around here), I’ll be disappointing Noriko next.
lines.zh: 但值得欣慰的是，今晚我和她的死对头也做了类似的约定，而如果历史重演（这一带通常都会），下一个被我放鸽子的就是 Noriko。

lines.en: And if there is anything I know about Maya, it’s that hurting Noriko will make her happy. I just...still don’t exactly understand {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: 而如果说我对 Maya 有什么了解的话，那就是——伤 Noriko 的心会让她开心。我只是……还是不太明白{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes! I win! Take that, Miku!
lines.zh: : 耶！我赢了！接招吧，Miku！

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach1
: I {i}told{/i} you Sensei wasn’t dead! He was probably just having a romantic rendezvous with a secret lover of his for hours and hours and hours last night!
lines.zh: : 我{i}就说{/i}老师没死！他昨晚大概是跟某个秘密情人浪漫幽会了好几个小时好几个小时好几个小时！

lines.en: : Man! I was really bankin’ on him bein’ eaten by bears.
lines.zh: : 靠！我还真指望他是被熊吃了呢。

lines.en: : What is it with everyone and wanting me mauled by bears this morning?
lines.zh: : 今天早上你们怎么一个个都盼着我被熊撕了？

lines.en: : What is it with you disappearing so early on in the night without so much as saying anything? Do you have any idea how many times I knocked on your door hoping that you were around? I was so bored.
lines.zh: : 那你又怎么回事，天刚黑就消失得无影无踪，一句话都不说？你知道我敲了多少次你的门，就盼着你在屋里吗？我无聊死了。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach2
: You should’a just hung out with me and Sana. All we did was play games and that ain’t much of a social thingy.
lines.zh: : 你该来跟我和 Sana 一起玩的。我们就打了打游戏，也不算什么社交。

lines.en: : I’ve seen the kinds of “games” she plays in her spare time and I have never been less interested in anything.
lines.zh: : 我见过她业余时间玩的那些"游戏"，我从没对任何事这么提不起兴趣过。

lines.en: : You got somethin’ against Minecraft, Io?
lines.zh: : Io，你对《我的世界》有意见啊？

lines.en: : Uta, thank you for believing in me when Miku and many others so clearly didn’t.
lines.zh: : Uta，谢谢你相信我——Miku 和好些人明显都不信。

lines.en: : Any time! You’re not off the hook {i}yet,{/i} though! Just cause I believed you were alive doesn’t mean I’m not also suspicious of your disappearance. Specially since Makoto and Futaba were gone all night as well.
lines.zh: : 随时效劳！不过你{i}还没{/i}脱身呢！我相信你活着，不代表我就不怀疑你失踪的事。尤其是 Makoto 和 Futaba 也整晚都不在。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach3
: Yeah! What was up with that?! I know Makoto’s been havin’ some sleepin’ problems, but she ain’t the type to just sneak out in the middle of the night without a good reason!
lines.zh: : 对啊！那是怎么回事？！我知道 Makoto 最近睡眠有问题，但她不是那种没有正当理由就半夜偷溜出去的人！

lines.en: : Well...maybe she had a good reason?
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许她有正当理由？

lines.en: : Like what? Gettin’ nasty with the teacher and everybody’s favorite librarian? This some kinda porno now?
lines.zh: : 比如呢？跟老师还有大家最喜欢的图书管理员乱搞？这现在是小黄片剧情了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, as if that would ever happen.
lines.zh: : 是啊，好像真会发生似的。

lines.en: if makotofutabafuntimelustevent == True:
: You look mighty pale all of a sudden, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师，你脸色突然白得厉害啊。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} look kinda like you saw a ghost right now. Not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你现在看起来{i}确实{/i}像见了鬼一样。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren12
scene anothermorningbeach3
else:
: Besides, if any of you were smart enough to check this morning, you would have realized that I {i}did{/i} come home last night. I slept in my room and everything.
lines.zh: : 再说，要是你们有谁今早聪明点去查一下，就会发现我昨晚{i}确实{/i}回来了。我还睡在自己房间里呢。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m smarter than the two of them combined.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我比她们俩加起来都聪明。

lines.en: : So is Ami and that’s not saying much.
lines.zh: : Ami 也比她们聪明，不过这也没什么好吹的。

lines.en: : Fair.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : Yeah, that tracks.
lines.zh: : 是啊，说得通。

lines.en: : Also, if you understood anything about how my stupid brain works, you would realize that coming to your room in the {i}morning{/i} is both nerve wracking and terrifying.
lines.zh: : 还有，要是你们稍微了解一点我这颗蠢脑袋的运作方式，就会明白{i}大早上{/i}跑到你房间去，既让人紧张又让人害怕。

lines.en: : I have walked in on one utterly disgusting thing during this vacation and was not about to risk the chance of walking in on a {i}second{/i} one that would just hurt my feelings as well.
lines.zh: : 这次度假我已经撞见过一次极其恶心的事了，可不想再冒风险撞见{i}第二次{/i}——何况那还会伤到我的感情。

lines.en: : Think Io means she didn’t wanna walk in on you railin’ Imani or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Io 的意思是，她不想撞见你在干 Imani 什么的。

lines.en: : Or anyone. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 或者干任何人。对。

lines.en: : Listen, what I do in my free time is for me to know and all of {i}you{/i} to ignore if you don’t want your feelings getting hurt.
lines.zh: : 听着，我业余时间做什么，我自己知道就好，{i}你们{/i}要是不想感情受伤，就当没看见。

lines.en: : But I can guarantee you that whatever it was didn’t involve Makoto or Futaba.
lines.zh: : 但我可以向你们保证，不管是什么，都跟 Makoto 和 Futaba 无关。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach4

: I don’t believe that at all. But if I try hard enough, I can {i}make{/i} myself believe it and continue to live happily inside of my own world where the only person who matters to you is me! And sometimes Uta.
lines.zh: : 我一个字都不信。不过只要我足够努力，就能{i}让{/i}自己相信，然后继续幸福地活在我自己的世界里——在那个世界里，你在乎的人只有我！有时候还有 Uta。

lines.en: : Yay...sometimes Uta...
lines.zh: : 好耶……有时候还有 Uta……

lines.en: Well, you can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: 好吧，你不能说我没试过。

lines.en: if makotofutabafuntimelustevent == True:
It’s just...lying through my teeth is way safer than telling the truth right now when the truth involves the most ejaculations I’ve had in one night since Chika lost her virginity.
lines.zh: 只是……现在睁眼说瞎话比说实话安全得多，因为实话涉及我自 Chika 破处以来一晚上射得最多的一次。

lines.en: else:
Especially since telling them I {i}was{/i} with those two girls but that nothing happened would be met with more doubt than just flat out lying.
lines.zh: 尤其是，跟她们说我跟那两个女孩{i}在{/i}一起但什么都没发生，会比干脆撒谎招来更多怀疑。

lines.en: : My night aside, what are you three doing out here so early? It seems like everyone else is still back at the inn.
lines.zh: : 先不说我的夜晚，你们三个这么早在这儿干什么？其他人好像都还在旅馆里。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach5
: You know what they say about the early bird getting the worm, don’t you? Well, today, that worm was sausage. And Uta loves herself some sausage.
lines.zh: : 你们知道早起的鸟儿有虫吃吧？嗯，今天的虫子是香肠。而 Uta 可喜欢香肠了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I could tell by the way you stared at me yesterday. And then asked me to come on you.
lines.zh: : 是啊。从你昨天盯着我看的样子就看得出来。然后你还让我射在你身上。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach6
: Hahah! Fun memory! Are you hungry?! Let’s eat!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！美好的回忆！你饿了吗？！我们开吃吧！

lines.en: : Uta too, Sensei?! Am I gonna start havin’ to make a list?!
lines.zh: : 老师连 Uta 也不放过？！我是不是得开始列个名单了？！

lines.en: : Just win a contest and make me write one. That’s been proven to work and only {i}temporarily{/i} harms the recipient.
lines.zh: : 赢一场比赛，逼我写一份就行了。这招已经验证有效，而且对接受者{i}只有暂时性{/i}伤害。

lines.en: : Boy, it sure is great being able to ignore everything I don’t like hearing! Looks like my brain’s getting a workout first thing this morning!
lines.zh: : 天哪，能把所有不爱听的话都屏蔽掉，可真是太棒了！看来我的大脑一大早就开始做运动了！

lines.en: : {i}Fix this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}收拾一下。{/i}

lines.en: : Fix what?
lines.zh: : 收拾什么？

lines.en: : {i}You’re making things awkward.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你把气氛搞得很尴尬。{/i}

lines.en: : I think it’s you who’s makin’ things awkward by whisperin’ so loudly the whole table can hear ya. And sayin’ all that stuff about lovin’ sausage. Course Sensei’s gonna capitalize on that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是你把气氛搞尴尬的——你"耳语"得整桌人都听得见。还说了一大堆什么喜欢香肠的。老师当然要抓住这个机会啊。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach7
: Just, uhh...just so we’re all on the same page and nobody harbors any ill-will against poor and defenseless Uta-chan for things you don’t have the context for...
lines.zh: : 只是，呃……只是想让大家达成共识，别因为你们不了解前因后果，就对可怜又无助的 Uta 酱怀恨在心——

lines.en: : The...{i}coming{/i} thing was...
lines.zh: : 那个……{i}射{/i}的事情是……

lines.en: : That was a slip of the tongue...
lines.zh: : 那是口误……

lines.en: : Hey, we don’t need to know what you’re doin’ with your tongue in your free time. I just didn’t think you guys were up to that kinda stuff together.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们不需要知道你业余时间拿舌头干什么。我只是没想到你们俩会一起搞那种事。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach8
: We’re not...and we never will be.
lines.zh: : 我们没有……而且永远不会。

lines.en: : So, onto topics that aren’t disgusting or inappropriate for the breakfast table, do you notice anything new about me?
lines.zh: : 那么，换个不恶心、也适合早餐桌的话题吧——你们有没有注意到我有什么新变化？

lines.en: : New? I’ve seen you with your hair down before. That’s not new.
lines.zh: : 新变化？我以前也见过你把头发放下来啊。那不算新。

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是那个。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Are you...on a new medication?
lines.zh: : 你……换了新药？

lines.en: : Nope. But that’s a fair guess.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过这猜得挺合理。

lines.en: : Io, I’m going to be honest. I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : Io，说实话。我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach9
: I did the thing you wanted me to do and made a new friend! I’ve been sitting next to Miku this whole time and haven’t been dying inside! Well, no more than usual at least.
lines.zh: : 我做了你希望我做的事——交了个新朋友！我一直坐在 Miku 旁边，而且心里没有痛苦到想死！好吧，至少没有比平时更想死。

lines.en: : And what’s even better is that it’s not Kirin!
lines.zh: : 更棒的是，那个人不是 Kirin！

lines.en: : She ain’t for everybody. I get it.
lines.zh: : 她不是人人都受得了的。我懂。

lines.en: : You and Miku are actually {i}friends{/i} now? That’s the least believable part of this timeskip yet.
lines.zh: : 你和 Miku 现在真的{i}是朋友{/i}了？这是这段时光飞逝里最不可置信的部分了。

lines.en: : Timeskip?
lines.zh: : 时光飞逝？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. How did {i}this{/i} happen, though? Miku’s one of the loudest- wait.
lines.zh: : 不重要。不过{i}这{/i}是怎么发生的？Miku 是嗓门最大的那——等等。

lines.en: : You confused her for a boy, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你把她当成男生了，对吧？

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach10
: Don’t worry, Io. I forget I’m a girl sometimes too.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Io。我有时也会忘了自己是个女孩。

lines.en: : Well, it {i}does{/i} help that she’s not annoyingly feminine...
lines.zh: : 嗯，她没有那种烦人的女人味，{i}确实{/i}有帮助……

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach11
: But we found something we can bond over!
lines.zh: : 但我们找到了可以拉近关系的东西！

lines.en: : Oh, right. You’re into baseball, aren’t you? Miku’s always been into sports-
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。你喜欢棒球吧？Miku 一直都挺喜欢运动的——

lines.en: : I ain’t that into baseball, actually. Think Io’s talkin’ about her anti-mind-explosion pills.
lines.zh: : 其实我没那么喜欢棒球。我觉得 Io 说的是她那些"防脑爆"药片。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I’ve designated myself as Miku’s personal pharmacist and have been sharing some of my meds with her lately to help with her PTSD!
lines.zh: : 我自封为 Miku 的私人药师，最近一直在把自己的药分给她一些，帮助她缓解创伤后应激障碍！

lines.en: : It’s actually been a huge help. I’ve only had a couple bad reactions so far and Io says it’s just cause she didn’t get the measurements right or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 真的帮了大忙。到目前为止我只出现过几次不良反应，Io 说那只是因为她没量准什么的。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I have...a strong and uncharacteristic urge to try and be responsible right now.
lines.zh: : 我……突然有一种强烈而反常的冲动，想试着负起点责任。

lines.en: : Suppress it. That’s what I do with all of the stuff I’m not supposed to feel.
lines.zh: : 压下去。我对所有不该有的感觉都是这么处理的。

lines.en: : I think Sensei’s right, Io. I’ve been wantin’ to say something, but I don’t really think it’s a good idea to be sharing that kind of stuff with Miku if she hasn’t been prescribed it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得老师说得对，Io。我一直想说，但如果 Miku 没有处方，我觉得你还是别把那种东西分给她比较好。

lines.en: : Not to mention I’m pretty sure that counts as drug dealing and is extremely illegal.
lines.zh: : 更别说我很确定那算贩毒，而且是严重违法的。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach12
: Technically, yes. But the chances of a girl my age actually getting in trouble for that sort of thing are basically non-existent. Plus, the meds have been helping a lot, haven’t they?
lines.zh: : 从技术上说，是的。但像我这个年纪的女孩，因为这档子事真惹上麻烦的概率基本为零。再说了，药确实帮了很大的忙，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! I feel great. Haven’t had a thing happen in almost a whole month. Might even be a new record.
lines.zh: : 对啊！我感觉好极了。快整整一个月什么都没发作过。说不定还是个新纪录呢。

lines.en: : Plus, I ain’t got the money for that kinda stuff and Io gets it all for free. So it’s like everybody’s winning, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 再说，我也没那个钱买那种东西，而 Io 全部都是免费拿的。所以这算是大家都赢，不是吗？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah, but...you’re not exactly a doctor and-
lines.zh: : 我是说……是啊，可是……你又不是医生，而且——

lines.en: : AH! THERE YOU ARE!
lines.zh: : 啊！你在这儿！

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach13
: Uh-oh. Looks like Sensei’s in trouble now and we should all focus on the things {i}he’s{/i} doing wrong instead of me being the Robin Hood of Valium.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。看来老师现在有麻烦了，我们都该把注意力放在{i}他{/i}做错的事上，而不是我这个"安定药罗宾汉"身上。

lines.en: : What do you think you’re doing disappearing for a whole night without checking in with me?! I was worried sick!
lines.zh: : 你一整晚都不见人影，连跟我报个平安都没有，你到底在干什么？！我担心死了！

lines.en: : I mean, if you really want to get technical, you took your eyes off of me during Ami time, so this is {i}kind of{/i} your-
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果你真要较真的话，Ami 时间的时候是你自己把目光从我身上移开的，所以这{i}其实{/i}是你的——

lines.en: : Don’t go blaming this on me, Mister! Not after I dragged Ayane and Maya around for hours looking for you in the middle of the night!
lines.zh: : 别想把这赖到我头上，先生！我可是拖着 Ayane 和 Maya 半夜三更找了你几个小时！

lines.en: : Just look at how mad Maya is! You interrupted her very strict sleeping schedule!
lines.zh: : 你看看 Maya 有多生气！你打乱了她非常严格的作息时间！

lines.en: : Yes, I’m sure that’s exactly why Maya is mad.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我敢肯定 Maya 就是为这个生气的。

lines.en: : Did he say something, Ami? I promised myself last night I’d never listen to another word he said.
lines.zh: : Ami，他说什么了？我昨晚对自己发过誓，再也不听他说的任何一个字。

lines.en: : Yes. He said he hates you and that he isn’t sorry for what he did because he is a giant, insensitive jerk who I still love more than anything in the world, but come on! You’re better than this!
lines.zh: : 是的。他说他恨你，还说他对自己的所作所为毫不后悔，因为他是个巨大、迟钝的混蛋——而这个混蛋我依然爱他胜过世上的一切，可是拜托！你比这强多了！

lines.en: : At least invite me out next time you vanish so I can make sure you’re not doing anything I disapprove of!
lines.zh: : 下次你消失之前，至少叫上我，这样我才能确保你没在做什么我不赞成的事！

lines.en: : Ami, I don’t have an excuse. I wandered off looking for people and then passed out. It’s that simple.
lines.zh: : Ami，我没有什么借口。我走开去找人了，然后就昏过去了。就这么简单。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach14
: That {i}is{/i} an excuse. And it's the {i}same{/i} excuse you've given me {i}every time{/i} you've come home super late.
lines.zh: : 那{i}就是{/i}个借口。而且{i}每次{/i}你回家特别晚，你给我的都是{i}同一个{/i}借口。

lines.en: : Yeah, so you should know that there is a precedent for this and that I’m not lying. Case closed.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以你该知道这是有先例的，而且我没撒谎。结案。

lines.en: : I’m not buying it. I sentence you to three consecutive years of Ami time, ending with high school graduation...
lines.zh: : 我不买账。我判你连续三年的 Ami 时间，一直到你高中毕业……

lines.en: : Which will then be followed by the two of us moving to a completely fenced-in facility where you are unable to leave without a passcode that only {i}I{/i} have.
lines.zh: : 之后我们俩搬进一个完全封闭的设施，没有只有{i}我{/i}才有的密码，你就出不去。

lines.en: : It’s only fair, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这才公平，老师。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound fair at all.
lines.zh: : 这听起来一点都不公平。

lines.en: : Sounds pretty fair to me. May I leave?
lines.zh: : 我觉得挺公平的。我可以走了吗？

lines.en: : Thank you, Maya. You are excused.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Maya。你可以退下了。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach15
Maya storms off and-
lines.zh: Maya 气冲冲地走开，然后——

lines.en: : {i}Die.{/i}
: {i}Do you really have to be this dramatic?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你非得这么夸张吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes.{/i}
: {i}Let me make it up to you tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}今晚让我补偿你吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I need you. Without you, I will simply perish.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我需要你。没有你，我会就此消亡。{/i}

lines.en: : Who do you think you’re texting while you’re supposed to be talking to me?
lines.zh: : 你本该在跟我说话，你以为你在给谁发短信？

lines.en: : Sorry. Just canceling all of my plans for the rest of eternity so we can spend that time together instead.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是把往后永恒里所有的计划都取消了，好把那些时间都用来陪你。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach16

: Great! In that case, I forgive you. And I have a whole list of activities planned out for the rest of the day where we can show our love for one another without the worry of anyone else getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那样的话，我原谅你了。而且我给今天剩下的时间安排了一整张活动清单，我们可以尽情表达彼此的爱，不用担心任何人来打扰。

lines.en: : Should I wear a leash? It might help with how controlling you want to be.
lines.zh: : 我要不要戴上项圈牵绳？这大概能满足你想控制我的欲望。

lines.en: : Sure! I packed one just in case you wound up seeing things my way and would be happy to break it in.
lines.zh: : 当然！我带了一条，就怕你最后会同意我的看法，我很乐意把它开个光。

lines.en: : Please tell me you don’t actually want to drag me around on a leash.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我你不是真的想用牵绳拴着我到处走。

lines.en: : Okay. I don’t actually want to drag you around on a leash.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我不是真的想用牵绳拴着你到处走。

lines.en: : Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami。

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach17
: I totally want to drag you around on a leash.
lines.zh: : 我完全就是想用牵绳拴着你到处走。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: For the millionth time, we can’t-
lines.zh: : 我都说第一百万遍了，我们不能——

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach18
: Yes! I know! You’ve made it loud and clear that you don’t care about how I feel! And that you’ll never look at me the same way I look at you!
lines.zh: : 对！我知道！你说得够大声够清楚了，你根本不在乎我的感受！你永远都不会用我看你的那种方式看我！

lines.en: : But if that’s the case, stop saying things that you {i}know{/i} are going to make my heart go crazy! Because there is only so much of it I can take before I break!
lines.zh: : 可既然如此，就别再说那些你{i}明知{/i}道会让我心跳失控的话了！因为我的承受能力是有限的，总有一天会碎掉！

lines.en: : Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : Holy shit. Ami’s really-
lines.zh: : 我操。Ami 是真的——

lines.en: scene anothermorningbeach19
: Just kidding! Tee-hee!
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的！嘻嘻！

lines.en: : Never mind. Ami is normal.
lines.zh: : 当我没说。Ami 很正常。

lines.en: : Yes. Ami is normal.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Ami 很正常。

lines.en: : Ami is so cute.
lines.zh: : Ami 好可爱。

lines.en: scene black
Ami drops the leash idea after a small bit of prodding and leads me to an annex of the beach inn that I have never noticed before.
lines.zh: 在我稍微劝了几句之后，Ami 放弃了牵绳的主意，带我走向海滩旅馆的一处配楼——那地方我之前从未注意过。

lines.en: It’s just beyond the manmade baths and half-concealed by fallen trees to the point where it would be very easy to overlook if you didn’t already know about it.
lines.zh: 它就在人工浴池再过去一点，被倒下的树遮住了一半，如果不是事先知道，很容易就忽略了。

lines.en: How she found out, I’m not sure. But I follow her regardless, staying closely behind until she opens the doors and signals for me to go in first.
lines.zh: 她是怎么发现的，我不确定。但我还是跟了上去，紧紧跟在她身后，直到她推开门，示意我先进去。
